evidence.claim: Flagged transaction 3446076 ($14.99, product S, online) scores 0.78 on the calibrated transaction model trained only on the bank's closed cases (out-of-time AUC 0.964 vs 0.866 for the bank's risk score). The bank's own risk score was 0.28.
Holder baseline from 67 earlier transactions: median $15.03, 95th percentile $25.06; the flagged amount is 1.0x the median.
Device profile 'Windows | Windows 8.1 | chrome 65.0 | 1366x768' was used by this holder before; identity record marks it New.
Simulated customer validation: Cardholder states they did not make this transaction and still has the card.
Card-not-present fraud from a new device: as above, with the identity record marking the device New for this account, sometimes behind a proxy.
Policy R2: Customer denies the transaction: BLOCK_CARD and CREATE_CASE; FILE_REPORT if exposure exceeds $1,000 or the case connects to a shared device profile or another card's fraud.

case.summary: Card not present new device on card C06962-K2: 2 transaction(s) from 2016-11-09 to 2016-11-10 totalling $29.92, probability 0.97. Cardholder states they did not make this transaction and still has the card.

evidence_requests.assumed_response: Cardholder states they did not make this transaction and still has the card.

initial.reason: §3b: probability 0.78 leans fraud; hold this authorization while the cardholder is asked, rather than block the card.
§5 and §3b: probability 0.78 is between 0.15 and 0.85, so ask the cardholder before deciding.
Policy §3a: fraud probability 0.78 is at or above 0.30, so the investigation is recorded as an internal case and written to the graph.

final.reason: R2: the cardholder denies the transaction, so the card is compromised.
R2: a denial requires an internal case with the evidence attached.

next_best_actions.what_changed: Cardholder states they did not make this transaction and still has the card. Probability moved 0.78 -> 0.97; added BLOCK_CARD, dropped DECLINE_TRANSACTION, VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER.

sar.reason: Policy §3a: fraud is suspected but no reporting trigger is met -- exposure $29.92 is under $1,000, the activity is isolated to this card, and the pattern is a known one. Case only, no report.

stop_reason: Policy §6: the customer denies the transaction, which settles the question. No further evidence would change the decision.
